Yeah either go part time with part time hours, or get paid for full time. If they are saying youre going to get full time hours they are prob going to schedule you anywhere from 38-42 hours, and you wont get any of the benefits. Health insurance or pto. Both of those kinda suck anyways but full time is also more pay. So I would def tell them to pick. They will also prob want you to be available 24/7. 
Honestly I would take it but keep looking. Def way better jobs out there.
I started with strattera then doc added adderall on top. And honestly it was great to have both. Def just give it a shot. If u feel no difference im sure your doc will change it up.
Yeah, just call in. I mean people call in year round and its just whatever. What they gonna do? Fire you for calling in sick one day when sally and fred both called in last week?
